indicator_name: Monetary survey of banks (other depository corporations), history from 1998 (NBK page records)
description: Монетарный обзор по банкам (история с 1998 г., данные страницы НБК)
unit: million KZT, stock at the end of the previous month (as at the date)
methodology: NBK page «Монетарный обзор по банкам» (records JSON), month-end stocks from 1998-01 dated the first day of the next month. Item ODC.<NBK key>. Quasi-fiscal lines: ODC.r_f_s_n_f_o = banks' claims on public nonfinancial organisations (897 205 mln at 2012-01-01, 318 120 at 2016-01-01, 605 536 at 2022-01-01, 1 239 746 at 2026-09-01; = IMF MFS_ODC); ODC.l_o = loans RECEIVED by banks, including from the NBK (728 538 at 2012-01-01 = IMF ODC loans 297 603 + liabilities to the central bank 430 937; 2 152 007 at 2022-01-01). ODC.r_f_n_b_f_i (claims on NBFIs) includes UAPF, insurers, KASE repo and BTA Bank after 2015 (3 315 926 at 2016-01-01) -- not development institutions only. The source has no record for 2003-04 and two for 2005-04; the one with reporting_date 2005-04-14 holds the 2003-04 values and is dated 2003-05-01 (it closes the BS = CB + ODC identity exactly). Identities enforced: d_a and l = n_e_a + d_a = liabilities, and BS claims on NBFIs / on the rest of the economy = CB + ODC from 2002-11-01.
